**Weights of Markov traces on Hecke algebras**

*November 16, 2021*

23 pp, 25 sections.

**Abstract.** We compute the weights, i.e. the values at the minimal idempo tents, for the Markov trace on the Hecke algebra of type Bn and type Dn. In order to prove the weight formula, we deﬁne representations of the Hecke algebra of ty pe B onto a reduced Hecke Algebra of type A. To compute the weights for type D we use the inclusion of the Hecke algebra of type D into the Hecke algebra of type B.
